name: TarenShaped
prompt:
OPAQUE WHITE PAPER BACKGROUND, fully opaque RGB image with solid white #FFFFFF in every empty region, including between limbs. No transparency or alpha channel, gradient, vignette or halo. Use case: stylized-concept. LATTICE production design. Crisp cel-shaded anime game art with restrained flat local-color regions and readable silhouettes. Even unshadowed studio illumination. No gloss, specular highlights, reflections, rim light, cast shadows, ground shadows, ambient occlusion, bloom spill, scenery, floor, particles, text, labels, watermark, borders or detached decorative parts. Emissive lines are opaque saturated color, not illumination. Every appendage is visibly rooted in its body.
Exactly ONE isolated complete subject, ONE view only, filling 80-88 percent of the canvas with clear margin on every side. No inset, turnaround, duplicate, cropped appendage or ground plane. This image will be reconstructed into 3D.
Use attached image 1 as the exact identity and proportions reference; image 2 supplies the approved Shaped palette/equipment direction. Produce exactly ONE front A-pose SHAPED form, not a board. Preserve the newer unique FACE from image 1. Vael: no external ears, no tail, no hair; flat overlapping keratin fronds, pale sclera, ring eyes, smooth matte slate skin.
Taren: broad blunt square-jawed face, small nose scar, hooded amber ring eyes, dark thick fronds with copper tips, broad shoulders. Amber sync #FFB62E, copper #C98254, ivory #C9C2AE armour and charcoal #283541 joints. Larger right wrist blade mount and smaller left emitter.
Replace Natural wraps with fitted segmented Lattice armour over forearms, shins, shoulders and chest. Keep the individual face and chin visible. A narrow light visor rests across the eyes, transparent enough to see both irises; no glass reflections. Plumes sheathed in thin matte ribs. Retract the energy blade fully for the reconstruction pose: a wrist blade socket remains, but no long blade obscures fingers. Left emitter is attached to forearm and leaves the hand unobscured. No cloth skirt or waist sash.
Exactly FOUR long thin BACK VANES, all rooted on the spine plate by separate short struts: two upper vanes and two lower vanes, paired left/right. They are folded mostly parallel to the spine, tilted only 8-15 degrees outward. Upper pair rises just above the shoulders; lower pair ends near hips. All FOUR dark rigid vane bodies must be separately visible, with white strips between their outer edges and the arms/body, except their narrow rooted struts. Vane width 0.08-0.12 torso width; each vane length 0.70-0.90 torso length. No detached floating vanes, extra fins, wings merging into arms or plates extending across limb gaps.
Single straight orthographic FRONT view, face aimed exactly with torso, calm closed mouth, neutral relaxed A pose: arms 30-40 degrees away from sides, palms forward, five relaxed separated digits with visible white gaps. Feet parallel, shoulder width apart. Unbroken wide white gaps between both arms and trunk, between legs from crotch down, between fingers, and around accessories. Wraps stay on the torso or their own leg and never bridge legs. No held props.
Five clearly separated digits per hand. Palette lines remain flat saturated marks, no bloom spill. Opaque white everywhere behind the figure.

name: SelaNatural

Use case: stylized-concept. LATTICE production design. Crisp cel-shaded anime game art with restrained flat local-color regions and readable silhouettes. Even unshadowed studio illumination. Vael alien anatomy: smooth matte slate skin and a lighter face/throat/palms, plantigrade biped, no tail, no external ears, no hair, no fur or scales. Swept-back elongated cranium, low sensory ridge behind jaw, soft low-bridge nose, almond eyes with readable pale sclera and ring irises. Crown/back crest consists of thick flat overlapping keratin FRONDS, not hair strands. Branching sync-lines run temple to jaw, collar to sternum, elbow to hand and knee to shin. Four fingers plus thumb per hand; all five separated. Forearm 1.06-1.12 times upper arm. Body 7.2-7.6 heads tall, adult 1.85-1.95m. Natural forms wear muted asymmetric wraps over a fitted underlayer with collar node, two wrist bands and a spine docking plate. Practical trousers stop short of feet: no long skirt bridging legs.
Sela Irun, adult female Vael hero in NATURAL form. Use the attached board for species, plume-mane, wraps and palette, but REFINE her face into a distinct identity: long diamond-shaped face with high angular cheek ridges, narrow tapered jaw and small off-center cleft in the chin, longer low-bridge nose with a softly upturned tip, wide-set narrow cyan ring eyes, sharply slanted asymmetric brow ridges (her RIGHT brow slightly raised), thin upper lip and fuller lower lip, a crooked closed half-smile. Three small darker slate pigment speckles under her LEFT eye provide a stable unique marking. Face width 0.64-0.71 face length; eye aperture width-to-height 2.7-3.1. No generic perfectly symmetrical doll face. Pale violet-white flat keratin plume-mane #D7CFF0 with lilac roots #9C8DC1, longer and finer than Taren but clearly thick fronds, not human hair. Matte slate-blue skin #718A9B and face #A2B7C4, fine branched cyan sync-lines #22F5FF. Fitted underlayer #334756, muted sand wraps and lilac sash #AE9CCF. Shoulder width 1.02-1.10 hip width, waist 0.86-0.93 hip width, 1.9m, practical athletic anatomy. No armour, visor, weapons, vanes or glow effects in this Natural reference. Keep long fronds behind shoulders and clear of arms. Her identity must contrast strongly with Taren's short broad face.
Single straight orthographic FRONT view, face aimed exactly with torso, calm closed mouth, neutral relaxed A pose: arms 30-40 degrees away from sides, palms forward, five relaxed separated digits with visible white gaps. Feet parallel, shoulder width apart. Unbroken wide white gaps between both arms and trunk, between legs from crotch down, between fingers, and around accessories. Wraps stay on the torso or their own leg and never bridge legs. No held props.
IMPORTANT: exactly one complete front A-pose figure on opaque white. Do not reproduce the multi-view board. Four fingers and one thumb clearly separated on BOTH hands.
